title: バイオ・化学大意(応用化学)
subtitle: Introduction to Bioscience and Chemistry (Applied Chemistry)
educationalGoal: Our college nurtures the understanding of chemical and biological phenomena, as well as the ability to develop analytical skills that lead to successful chemical and biotechnological engineers. The objective of this course is to provide an understanding of the importance of university study, encourage the development of an attitude conducive to learning and curiosity, and develop the ability to prepare a plan to realize your future career goals.
advice: 1. System of bioscience and chemistry (understand the 4-year curriculum flow chart) 2. Applications of chemistry in various industrial fields 3. Introduction to research fields and methods of fostering scientific reasoning 4. Introduction to state-of-the-art research by professors of the department 5. General exercises (writing assignments will be added to the portfolio)
requiredKnowledge: No prerequisites. Prepare for and review the material for class every week.

activityGoals.body: Prepare a learning plan yourself, based on an understanding of the activities of bioscience and chemistry.
Prepare a learning plan yourself, based on an understanding of the educational objectives of the department.
Explain the significance of studying at the university.
Explain the roles of chemical engineers in the chemistry fields.
Consider and explain the future development of chemistry fields.
Describe your career plans and future goals.
